headline: TE Cole Kmet exits Bears' win vs. Patriots with knee injury
summary: Bears tight end Cole Kmet exited Thursday night's game against the Patriots on a cart after injuring his right knee in the fourth quarter.

headline: Ben Johnson: Cole Kmet's knee injury doesn't look good
